mainEntity.name: What types of residential glazing are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Residential glazing refers to the glass used in windows and doors of homes. Common types include single-pane, double-pane (insulated glass units or IGUs), and triple-pane windows. Single-pane glass offers minimal insulation, while double and triple panes significantly improve energy efficiency by creating air or gas-filled gaps between glass layers. The choice depends on your insulation needs, budget, and local climate. For example, in areas like Berkeley where energy efficiency is a key consideration, double or triple-pane options are often preferred to help manage heating and cooling costs.
